events.title: Pacific Makers Market
events.venue: The Pacific Motel, 399 S. Ocean Ave, Cayucos, CA 93430
events.summary: 3rd Annual outdoor market with local artisan vendors, handmade gifts, jewelry, home décor, live music, food & drinks. Free admission.

events.title: Shoreline Inn Holiday Light Display
events.venue: Shoreline Inn on the Beach, 1 N. Ocean Ave, Cayucos, CA 93430
events.summary: Over 25,000 holiday lights illuminate the inn nightly 6–11:30pm, Thanksgiving through Jan 6. Free drive-by/walk-up viewing.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos — Tree Lighting
events.venue: Corner of D Street & Ocean Avenue, Downtown Cayucos, CA 93430
events.organizer: Cayucos Chamber of Commerce / Cayucos Rotary
events.summary: Community tree lighting with live music by the White Caps, carolers, Santa arriving by fire engine, and warm holiday refreshments. Free.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos — Wonderland Walk
events.organizer: Cayucos Chamber of Commerce / Cayucos Lioness Club
events.summary: Holiday stroll along Ocean Ave with horse-drawn carriage rides, Santa photos, kids' snow play area, craft workshop & Lioness Club refreshments. Free.
